[SWS_FrNm_00569]
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_02572
⌈If FrNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and FrNm_Acti-
vateTxPnShutdownMsg is called with a valid NM-Channel (nmChannelHandle), then
the FrNm module shall set the PNSR bit in the CBV to 1 on the given NM-channel and
return with E_OK.⌋
